title: Retry amplification against a mildly slow downstream exhausts checkout connection and thread pools
source_note: Failure pattern (a small downstream latency increase amplified by un-budgeted client retries into an upstream resource exhaustion / cascading outage) follows the retry-storm scenario described in the AWS Builders' Library article on timeouts, retries, and backoff. All services, logs, metrics, and timestamps are fabricated for evaluation.
incident_report: Checkout started returning 503s to a growing share of users around 09:23 UTC. Error rate on checkout-api is elevated and latency is high. No deploys went out today. Payments processing also looks a bit slow. On-call is unsure whether checkout or payments is the real problem.

signal_lines.msg: retrying payments-api call (attempt 3/5); no backoff or retry budget configured for this client
DB connection pool exhausted (size=20, active=20, waiters=140)
worker thread pool exhausted; rejecting inbound requests
operator lowered payments-api client retry budget to 1; connection pool draining

ground_truth.root_cause: A modest latency increase in payments-api (read-replica lag pushed p95 from ~90ms to ~400ms) triggered aggressive retries from checkout-api's payments client, which had no backoff and no retry budget. Retry amplification roughly 5x'd checkout-api's outbound request volume, which exhausted its database connection pool and then its worker thread pool, turning a minor downstream slowdown into a checkout outage.
evidence_path: payments-api p95 latency rises from ~90ms to ~400ms at 09:15 due to read-replica lag
checkout-api logs slow payments-api calls, then 'retrying ... no backoff or retry budget' at 09:19
checkout-api outbound request rate climbs from ~120/s to ~640/s (retry amplification)
checkout-api DB connection pool exhausted at 09:21 (waiters=140) and pool wait time spikes
checkout-api worker thread pool exhausted -> HTTP 503 at 09:23
no deploys occurred in the window; recovery follows the operator cutting the retry budget
ground_truth.fix: Add exponential backoff with jitter and a retry budget / circuit breaker to checkout-api's payments-api client, isolate the connection pool used for downstream calls, and add load shedding. Separately, address the payments-api read-replica lag.
